source: due2-native: a concept scheme on an operand whose range is a datatype (decisions/0015 #8; issue #69)
notes: Authored for due2. The policy is valid ODRL 2.2; the rejection is due2's own.

expected_rejection.why: ex:purposeCode has range xsd:string, so its values are never IRIs and never concepts, yet its binding names a concept scheme. due2-profiles.md §4 rejects the binding with InvalidBinding.
